summary: Two clients on a NIFTY future: a Quote holder, then a Depth 20 subscribe (acknowledged as 5) moves Arrow from quote to full; one full packet serves both, the Quote frame with the OI the full packet carries; the Depth holder leaving moves Arrow back to quote and the Quote holder keeps streaming.

notes: The web proxy releases (symbol, exchange, mode) on its own: the Depth holder leaving calls the adapter's unsubscribe for mode 3, which drops the token from Arrow entirely (arrow_websocket.py:344-365), so the web's Quote holder receives nothing more.

deviations.reason: The desktop puts its mode label (ltp, quote, full) in data.mode; the Arrow web adapter sends no data.mode. Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

The Arrow web adapter adds the broker's instrument token as a string to every frame; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it. Whether the desktop carries it is the lead's decision (a broker identifier, not a market field).
The Arrow web adapter repeats ltp as last_price in every frame; the desktop sends no such alias yet.
The Arrow web adapter repeats the previous close as prev_close wherever it sends close; the desktop sends no such alias yet.
The web sends the change against the previous close for every instrument whose packet carries a close (ltpc, quote, full); the desktop sends it in index Quote and Depth frames only.

deviations.reason: The web sends the packet's OI in Quote frames (Arrow's quote packet carries it); the desktop's Quote frame carries OI only when the tick came from a full packet.

The web forwards the full packet's DEPTH publish unchanged to a Quote holder (server.py fan-out to lower modes), book and circuits included; the desktop renders the Quote holder's frame at Quote.
Circuit limits, which the desktop's carrier drops (audit C06), reach the Quote holder on the web through the fan-out of the DEPTH publish (audit C08).

When the Depth holder leaves, the web proxy asks the Arrow adapter to unsubscribe mode 3 only, and the adapter unsubscribes the whole token from Arrow (arrow_websocket.py:344-365) and forgets it (arrow_adapter.py:167): the Quote holder still subscribed on the web receives nothing more. The desktop moves Arrow back to quote and keeps streaming to it.
